name: Market Intelligence
summary: A local market research dashboard with stock screens, hypothesis tracking, and manual portfolio analysis.
why: Brings historical prices, company context, and saved research into one workspace.
technical: A local DuckDB warehouse retains dated observations and ingestion provenance. The browser reads exported snapshots and provides transparent screens, versioned hypothesis logs, and local portfolio inputs.
demonstrates: Local data storage, dated source snapshots, and calculations that can be inspected.
boundary: Research-only historical snapshots. No broker or trade execution; option chains, implied volatility, and option mark-to-market are not connected.

name: Referral
summary: A career planning workspace that compares opportunities against goals, experience, and saved evidence.
why: Keeps career profiles, job opportunities, contacts, and next steps in one place.
technical: Deterministic scoring exposes its component breakdown, matched evidence, and gaps. Isolated industry workspaces persist in browser storage.
demonstrates: Configurable scoring, visible evidence gaps, and separate browser-local workspaces.
boundary: Synthetic profiles and opportunities. Login, billing, live research sources, and external AI drafting are not connected.

name: Powderline
summary: A Colorado resort camera dashboard with resort filters, on-demand video, and links to official conditions.
why: Lets users check cameras across several resorts without opening each provider separately.
technical: A curated camera catalog handles provider differences, on-demand video, resort filtering, and refresh failures while retaining the last successful image.
demonstrates: Multiple camera providers, refresh handling, and clear states for unavailable data.
boundary: Camera availability depends on providers. Resort report adapters, live road conditions, accounts, and alerts are not connected.

name: EasyEcom
summary: A configurable storefront with collection pages, product variants, and a demonstration shopping bag.
why: Tests a shared storefront against different brand and catalog configurations.
technical: Typed brand configuration separates catalog and identity from commerce components. Variant validation and integer pricing keep the demonstration bag consistent.
demonstrates: Typed brand configuration, variant validation, and reusable shopping components.
boundary: Concept artwork and illustrative catalog. Captured in POC mode with simulated checkout and payments disabled.

name: SimpleSLP
summary: A speech-language therapy prototype for patient records, goals, visits, and AI-assisted drafts.
why: Connects each case to its goals, interventions, and recorded outcomes.
technical: A relational case-to-outcome model supports auditable records and draft-to-approval document workflows. AI drafts default to a deterministic offline provider.
demonstrates: Relational records, draft approval workflows, and an offline mock AI provider.
boundary: Fresh synthetic patient records only. Mock AI is the default; this prototype is not validated for clinical use.
